description: Aesthetics decomposed. Beauty theories (objective vs subjective), Kant on aesthetic judgement, sublime, artistic representation, expression theory, formalism, institutional theory of art, aesthetic experience, modernism + postmodernism, computational aesthetics.

sub_mechanisms.name: beauty_objective_subjective
sub_mechanisms.definition: Beauty in object (objective) vs beholder (subjective). Ancient debate.
sub_mechanisms.why: Plato: objective Form. Hume: subjective response. Kant: subjective but universal. Foundation aesthetics.

sub_mechanisms.name: Kant_aesthetic_judgement
sub_mechanisms.definition: Critique of Judgement 1790. Aesthetic judgement disinterested, universal, purposive without purpose.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern aesthetics. Free play of imagination + understanding. Influence: art theory, philosophy of mind.

sub_mechanisms.name: sublime_Burke_Kant
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mountains, storms, vastness. Beyond beauty. Awe + terror combined.
sub_mechanisms.why: Distinct aesthetic category. Foundation Romantic aesthetics. Modern: space, AI capability evoke.

sub_mechanisms.name: representation_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Art = mimesis (imitation of reality). Plato critical; Aristotle positive.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation classical aesthetics. Goodman's symbol theory modern revival. Cost: abstract art doesn't represent.

sub_mechanisms.name: expression_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Art = expression of artist's feelings. Tolstoy, Croce, Collingwood.
sub_mechanisms.why: Romantic foundation. Cost: emphasises emotion over form. Influence: modernist art.

sub_mechanisms.name: formalism_Bell_Fry
sub_mechanisms.definition: Significant form alone makes art. Bell: 'significant form' aesthetic emotion.
sub_mechanisms.why: Influence on modern abstract art. Cost: doesn't explain content + meaning.

sub_mechanisms.name: institutional_theory_art
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dickie: artwork = artifact granted status by artworld.
sub_mechanisms.why: Handles found objects + conceptual art. Cost: what makes artworld legitimate? Circular?

sub_mechanisms.name: aesthetic_experience_Dewey
sub_mechanisms.definition: Art as Experience 1934. Aesthetic experience: heightened, integrated.
sub_mechanisms.why: Pragmatist aesthetics. Continuity art + life. Influence: aesthetic everyday + education.

sub_mechanisms.name: modernism_avant_garde
sub_mechanisms.definition: Break with tradition. Form innovation. Abstraction. ~1890-1970.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern art. Influence: design, architecture. Cost: alienation from public.

sub_mechanisms.name: postmodernism_art
sub_mechanisms.definition: Pastiche, irony, multiplicity. Suspicious of grand narratives.
sub_mechanisms.why: 1970s+. Influence beyond art. Critique of modernism's confidence. Foundation contemporary art theory.

sub_mechanisms.name: computational_creativity
sub_mechanisms.definition: Can computers create art? Generative AI raises acutely.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern question. Boden: psychological + historical creativity. AI art (DALL-E, Stable Diffusion) drives debate.

sub_mechanisms.name: evolutionary_aesthetics
sub_mechanisms.definition: Beauty preferences adaptations. Savannah hypothesis, face symmetry.
sub_mechanisms.why: Empirical aesthetics. Pinker, Dutton. Cost: limited explanation of cultural variation. Foundation cog sci of aesthetics.

derivation_rules.name: Kant_aesthetic_universality_via_disinterest
derivation_rules.why: Kant: not pleasure of senses (interested) nor moral (interested). Free play yields universal subjective claim. Foundation modern aesthetics.

derivation_rules.name: institutional_theory_handles_modern_art
then: status as art comes from institutional context, not properties
derivation_rules.why: Ready-mades broke representation + expression + formalism. Institutional theory handles. Cost: vagueness.

derivation_rules.name: AI_art_challenges_creativity_concepts
derivation_rules.why: DALL-E, Midjourney era. Tests definitions: novel? valued? by whom? Substrate's structural-not-statistical aligns with Boden's H-creativity.

derivation_rules.name: evolutionary_aesthetics_partial_explanation
derivation_rules.why: Savannah views, symmetric faces. Cost: doesn't explain cultural variation + change. Empirical + cognitive aesthetics extends.

derivation_rules.name: sublime_distinct_from_beautiful
derivation_rules.why: Burke + Kant distinction. Vastness + power + terror. Modern: nature, technology can evoke. Foundation Romantic aesthetics.
